fusions.name: Cull the Stand
fusions.desc: A felling chop that deals 22 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Kindling Scatter
fusions.desc: Chops through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 13 damage to everything in it and leaving each enemy [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Upturned Edge
fusions.desc: Leaves the head lying edge-up at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 22 damage.

fusions.name: Windfall
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 12 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
